title: BNMU University UG Admission 2026-30 Online Form
publishedDate: Publication of 1st Merit list & Cut-off list
intro: Bhupendra Narayan Mandal University (BNMU, Bihar) has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for Admission in Undergraduate (UG)/ Graduation/ Degree Course (B.A/ B.Sc/ B.Com) For Academic Session 2026-30 for 4 year programme under Choice Based Credit System (CBCS). Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to BNMUG UG Admission. Online Apply Start On May 22, 2026 & Last Date for Application is June 5, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Payment Mode:    Pay Exam Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking Fee Mode.
UG Arts: Candidates who have passed intermediate examination I.A./ I.Sc./ I.Com or +2 of Bihar School Examination Board or equivalent examination offered by other approved National / State Board
UG Science: Candidates who have passed intermediate examination I.A./ I.Sc./ I.Com or +2 of Bihar School Examination Board or equivalent examination offered by other approved National / State Boards.

UG Commerce: Candidates who have passed intermediate examination I.Sc. or +2 Science Stream only of Bihar School Examination Board or equivalent examinations offered by other approved National / State Boards.

B.A (Hons) :- Home Science, English, Statistics, Economics, Hindi, Maithili, Pol.Sc, A.I.H & Culture, Anthropology, Geography, History, Mathematics, Music, Philosophy, Psychology, R. Economics, Sanskrit, Sociology, Urdu, Arabic, Bangala, L.S.W, Persian.
B.Sc. (Hons) :- Botany, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, Zoology, Geology, Statistics.
05 June 2026: Last date for registration & fee payment.
Passed 10+2 / Intermediate from Bihar School Examination Board or equivalent recognized board.
